SELECT tstamp AS "time",
       CASE cu_du_id WHEN 3585 THEN 'cuup_co (CU-UP 0xe01)'
                     WHEN 3586 THEN 'cuup_e (CU-UP 0xe02)'
                     ELSE 'CU-UP ' || cu_du_id END AS metric,
       SUM(measure_value) AS value
FROM KPM_MeasRecord
WHERE meas_name = 'DRB.PdcpSduVolumeDL' AND ngran_type = 'ngran_gNB_CUUP'
  AND tstamp BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000
GROUP BY tstamp, cu_du_id
ORDER BY tstamp
